aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Canada at 61.1% (market share of tracked page views / usage). OS X ranked second at 23.31%, followed by macOS at 7.75%.

faqs.question: Which item leads operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Canada?
faqs.answer: Windows leads at 61.1% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/os-market-share/desktop/canada.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Canada?
faqs.answer: Windows (61.1%), OS X (23.31%), macOS (7.75%) in October 2026.
